text: What does it mean when she takes days to reply? So here's the situation. She doesn't reply for a few days. And when you ask why, she hits you with, oh, I didn't see your message. Here's the rule. If she's your girlfriend, or you've already been on a few dates and she disappears for days, that's a problem. She basically tells you that you are not important to her. Walk away. But if you've never even met, haven't been on a date yet, then bro, chill. It's just texting. You don't need to get emotional over someone who is basically a stranger. If she replies, even late, and you keep it fun and playful, great. Next step, set up a date. That's the real test. If she's not very active during the texting phase, but she agrees to meet, who cares about texting? But you need to act correctly when you meet in real life. If your date goes well with her being comfortable, you both having a good time, touching, kissing, and then maybe even you two going back to your place, then afterwards, her texting might become more active too. Now, if she keeps flaking or ghosting after you've already been out with her, that's your cue to move on. Don't chase someone who doesn't respect you enough to even text you back.
